name: Elimination Tournament
description: Multi-round survival game: respond, everyone votes, the lowest-scoring players are out, repeat until one is left. Students who are out keep voting.
tagline: Perfect for high-energy competitions and 'last one standing' classroom games.

prompt.label: Prompt students will answer each round
prompt.helper: Same prompt every round, students give a fresh answer each time.
prompt.placeholder: What's a creative use for a paper clip?

rounds.label: Most rounds
rounds.helper: The game ends as soon as one student is left standing, however many rounds that takes. This only caps how long it can run.

elimPercent.label: Percent eliminated each round
elimPercent.helper: Bottom percent (by votes received) is out each round. Students who are out still vote.

template.name: Tournament: ${prompt}
template.description: An elimination tournament built with the Elimination Tournament recipe.

round-intro.message: Round {{_loop.eliminate.iteration}}. {{remaining.length}} still in: answer the prompt and survive the vote!

vote.question: Pick your favorite (not your own). Everyone votes, in or out.
